 W.P.(C).Nos.1182/2015 & 18787/2015  ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
 Dated this the 26th Day of September, 2015
J U D G M E N T
These writ petitions are filed at the instance of the same petitioner, in connection with operation of a mobile Icecream unit by one J.Deepa.
J.Deepa is the 8th respondent in W.P.(C).No.1182 of 2015 and M.M. Yacoob vs State Of Kerala on 1 September, 2014 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/124813528/

entities.text: M.M. Yacoob vs State Of Kerala
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5 the 4th respondent in W.P.(C).No.18787 of 2015
. The other party respondent in both the writ petitions appears to be the person engaged by J.Deepa.
W.P. (C).No.1182 of 2015 is filed alleging that J.Deepa is causing nuisance to the petitioner by placing the mobile Icecream unit in front of the petitioner's bunk, which is a no parking area.
And further that on account of placing the mobile Icecream unit, his business is being affected.
W.P.(C).No.18787 of 2015 is filed to take action against J.Deepa for violation of the terms and conditions of Ext.P8 licence issued by the Corporation.

2. It appears from the pleadings of the writ petitioner that the writ petitioner is now very much aggrieved by the operation of the mobile Icecream unit by J.Deepa or her employee in front of his bunk.
The limited question therefore arises is whether any nuisance is being caused by the mobile Icecream unit operated by J.Deepa.
J.Deepa has filed a detailed counter affidavit.
She refers to an earlier writ petition and submits that she is operating the mobile Icecream unit, scrupulously, following the terms and conditions.
4. It is to be noted that the litigation has a chequered career.
Now, the fact remains that the Corporation has issued a vending license to J.Deepa which is not challenged before this Court.
Therefore, the only question to be considered is whether the mobile Icecream unit causes any nuisance to the petitioner or not.

The licence issued by the Corporation is produced as Exhibit R5(d)
in W.P.(C).No.18787 of 2015.
Exhibit R5(a) produced therein is the no-objection certificate issued by the PWD Roads Division which would show that the operational area is in front of the Museum and through R.K.V. road.

5 . This Court is of the view that since J.Deepa is operating the mobile unit, the Corporation may identify the location through which the mobile Icecream unit has to be operated and also the area for parking the mobile unit by J.Deepa so as not to cause any hindrance or obstruction to the petitioner's business.
The mobility of the unit need not be restricted as permission has been granted for operating through R.K.V road.
Identification has to be done only to avert any of possible complaint on the part of the petitioner, alleging obstruction to his bunk's function.
The W.P.(C).Nos.1182/2015 & 18787/2015 Corporation shall identify such other location to facilitate business of J.Deepa and also ensure not to cause any hindrance to the petitioner's business.
The Corporation shall specify the same after conducting site inspection.
The writ petitions are disposed of as above.
No costs.

Sd/-
A.MUHAMED MUSTAQUE, JUDGE ms M.M. Yacoob vs State Of Kerala on 1 September, 2014 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/124813528/
